reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both selected objects. Q-20260912-01 preserves the primary study's evidence-ablation, planner-reliability and fixed-intent execution-guard results, including the negative finding that a typed relation did not outperform equal raw receipts and the boundary that a guard cannot manufacture a missing valid intent. Q-20260912-02 inspected the exact merged Codex, MCP TypeScript SDK and Gemini CLI changes and their tests. Codex revalidates retained provider selection/definition against current managed requirements before selected model-driving or state-changing operations, fails closed on mismatch or requirement-load error, avoids queue/goal mutation on rejection and preserves stop controls. MCP constructs Headers from caller input and then case-insensitively sets runtime-managed Authorization, protocol-version and session-id values, preserving configured Authorization only until the provider has a token. Gemini CLI denies sandbox access to credential, trust, policy-integrity and environment-secret state, sanitizes sandbox settings, and permits user-global commands while excluding project/extension commands in untrusted folders. The samples support three bounded patterns—revalidation, deterministic replacement and isolation—but are first-party engineering evidence at different layers, not independent proof of one universal architecture. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
